confidence.note: Only units covered ≥ 95% by the downloaded tiles are listed (terrain: 22–25 °E × 45–47 °N; land cover: 21–27 °E × 45–48 °N). Slope is in percent (rise / run × 100) from the 30 m SRTM DEM; cropland = WorldCover class 40. Above ~10 % slope, water erosion on bare soil rises steeply, so steep cropland benefits most from winter cover and contour work.
